lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 12 distinct vertical white lines; spacing is wider on the anterior torso and narrows significantly toward the posterior.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Dashed segments observed on the posterior haunch where vertical lines break into discrete circular blobs.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of approximately 8 spots on the lower hind limb, most concentrated near the posterior edge of the white haunch markings.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Three distinct spots align horizontally across the mid-thigh region.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Horns exhibit a tight spiral with a lyrate silhouette, curving outward from the base and then inward at the tips.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: Approximate 1:1.2 ratio of tip-to-tip distance relative to the combined width of the horn bases.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: Upper 10% of horn length consists of high-contrast ivory tipping.

other_distinctive_markers: White facial chevron, white maxillary spots, and a prominent white dorsal crest extending from the neck to the tail.
